name: Joou Ari no Perfume Episode 0 -Kirisaki Jack no Kyou Ai-
original_name: 女王蟻のPerfume エピソード０-切り裂きジャックの狂愛-
source: A visual novel game set in “London at the end of the 19th century” and “modern Tokyo”. The game depicts a love episode between you and a male suspect that “Watson-kun,” the assistant of a famous detective (you), witnesses while investigating a threatening letter sent by Jack the Ripper.
translation: 一款以“19世纪末的伦敦”和“现代东京”为背景的视觉小说游戏。游戏讲述了你和一名男性嫌疑人之间的爱情故事，一名著名侦探（你）的助手“华生君”在调查开膛手杰克发出的威胁信时目睹了这一事件。
